messages:
sam: Heads-up — prototyping a small 'route explainability' feature at the gateway. Goal: give engineers a concise reason why a request was routed to a particular workspace/pool/VPC without spamming logs. Draft header idea: `X-Redwood-Route: workspace=acme, pool=dedicated-gpu-1, reason=workspace-affinity`. Thoughts on telemetry/PII/console UX?

jules: 👍 useful for debugging. Main worry is info leakage — we can't send raw workspace ids to downstream services or partners. Need strict downstream redaction.

morgana: Agree on redaction. Proposal: minimal headers for downstream, full detail only in internal telemetry. Telemetry event shape sketch: 
```
route_decision: {
  route_trace_id: "rt-abc123",
  reason_code: "workspace_affinity",
  latency_ms: 12,
  cost_estimate: 0.002
}
```
We should avoid including raw tenant identifiers in the event body unless hashed.

product-alex: From console product side — we should surface the "why" in the request log UX. Suggest a per-org toggle "Show route explanations" (off by default). For rollouts, sample view for orgs in beta.

tanya: For rollout policy, do we want sampling global or per-workspace? Also need a forced-off flag for compliance-sensitive tenants.

jules: Implementation idea: gateway samples route decisions at ingress (configurable sample_rate). Sampled events go to telemetry pipeline with route_trace_id. Per-workspace override can live in tenant settings, but yes we must enforce an opt-out. Note this affects quota/ingest costs.

sam: Header surface should be minimal: `x-rd-route-reason` (short code) and `x-rd-route-trace` (opaque id that maps to internal trace). Then console can fetch trace details by id. Keeps downstream header small.

morgana: +1 for opaque id. Telemetry schema should include: [route_trace_id, reason_code(enum), pool_id(hashed), fallback_chain(array of reason_codes), chosen_model_variant, decision_time_ms]. No plain workspace id.

product-alex: Console UX: show a small pill next to each request with reason_code label and hover -> link to trace. For sampled traces, show "sampled" badge. Need copy for admins explaining privacy.

tanya: Rollout plan: internal only -> selected beta orgs -> opt-in for more orgs -> global default off. We'll provide an API flag `explainability:{enabled, sample_rate, redaction_level}`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Feature branch feature/gw-route-explainability created. Staging -> canary -> prod pipeline queued. Canary sample_rate=1% initially. ETA: tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

sam: Actionables: jules — gateway PR for headers + sampling config; morgana — telemetry schema PR + masking rules; product-alex — console mock + admin copy; tanya — list beta orgs and compliance opt-outs. I'll post PR link here when ready.

jules: Will open PR today with tests covering header redaction and sampling.

morgana: I'll draft schema and add parsers for route_trace_id to our trace service.

sam: Thanks all. We'll keep headers minimal and rely on opaque trace ids for explainability.
